verses.original: טֽוֹב־ רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ וְה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- rāš hō·w·lêḵ bə·ṯum·mōw wə·hū ḵə·sîl śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw mê·‘iq·qêš
verses.literal: Better a poor man who walks with integrity - than a fool whose lips are perverse

verses.original: גַּ֤ם נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּלֹא־ ט֑וֹב לֹא־ דַ֣עַת וְאָ֖ץ בְּרַגְלַ֣יִם חוֹטֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: gam ne·p̄eš bə·lō- ṭō·wḇ lō- ḏa·‘aṯ wə·’āṣ bə·raḡ·la·yim ḥō·w·ṭê
verses.literal: Even zeal is no good without knowledge and he who hurries his footsteps misses the mark

verses.original: אָ֭דָם אִוֶּ֣לֶת תְּסַלֵּ֣ף דַּרְכּ֑וֹ לִבּֽוֹ׃ יִזְעַ֥ף וְעַל־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām ’iw·we·leṯ tə·sal·lêp̄ dar·kōw lib·bōw yiz·‘ap̄ wə·‘al- Yah·weh
verses.literal: A man’s own folly subverts his way yet his heart rages against the LORD

verses.original: ה֗וֹן יֹ֭סִיף רַבִּ֑ים רֵעִ֣ים וְ֝דָ֗ל יִפָּרֵֽד׃ מֵרֵ֥עהוּ
verses.transliteration: hō·wn yō·sîp̄ rab·bîm rê·‘îm wə·ḏāl yip·pā·rêḏ mē·rē·ʿ·hū
verses.literal: Wealth attracts many friends but a poor man is deserted by his friend

verses.original: שְׁ֭קָרִים עֵ֣ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִמָּלֵֽט׃
verses.transliteration: šə·qā·rîm ‘êḏ lō yin·nā·qeh wə·yā·p̄î·aḥ kə·zā·ḇîm lō yim·mā·lêṭ
verses.literal: A false witness will not go unpunished and one who utters lies will not escape

verses.original: רַ֭בִּים יְחַלּ֣וּ פְנֵֽי־ נָדִ֑יב וְכָל־ הָ֝רֵ֗עַ לְאִ֣ישׁ מַתָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bîm yə·ḥal·lū p̄ə·nê- nā·ḏîḇ wə·ḵāl hā·rê·a‘ lə·’îš mat·tān
verses.literal: Many seek the favor of the prince and everyone is a friend of the gift giver

verses.original: כָּ֥ל אֲחֵי־ רָ֨שׁ׀ שְֽׂנֵאֻ֗הוּ אַ֤ף כִּ֣י מְ֭רֵעֵהוּ רָחֲק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ מְרַדֵּ֖ף אֲמָרִ֣ים הֵֽמָּה׃ לֹא
verses.transliteration: kāl ’ă·ḥê- rāš śə·nê·’u·hū ’ap̄ kî mə·rê·‘ê·hū rā·ḥă·qū mim·men·nū mə·rad·dêp̄ ’ă·mā·rîm hêm·māh lō
verses.literal: All the brothers of a poor man hate him how much more . . . do his friends avoid him He may pursue them with pleading but they are nowhere to be found

verses.original: קֹֽנֶה־ לֵּ֭ב אֹהֵ֣ב נַפְשׁ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֥ר תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה לִמְצֹא־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: qō·neh- lêḇ ’ō·hêḇ nap̄·šōw šō·mêr tə·ḇū·nāh lim·ṣō- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: He who acquires wisdom loves himself one who safeguards understanding will find success

verses.original: שְׁ֭קָרִים עֵ֣ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֖יחַ כְּזָבִ֣ים יֹאבֵֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: šə·qā·rîm ‘êḏ lō yin·nā·qeh wə·yā·p̄î·aḥ kə·zā·ḇîm yō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: A false witness will not go unpunished and one who pours out lies will perish

verses.original: תַּעֲנ֑וּג לֹֽא־ נָאוֶ֣ה לִכְסִ֣יל אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־ לְעֶ֤בֶד׀ מְשֹׁ֬ל בְּשָׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ta·‘ă·nūḡ lō- nā·weh liḵ·sîl ’ap̄ kî- lə·‘e·ḇeḏ mə·šōl bə·śā·rîm
verses.literal: Luxury vvv is unseemly for a fool how much worse . . . for a slave to rule over princes

verses.original: אָ֭דָם שֵׂ֣כֶל הֶאֱרִ֣יךְ אַפּ֑וֹ וְ֝תִפאַרְתּ֗וֹ עֲבֹ֣ר עַל־ פָּֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām śê·ḵel he·’ĕ·rîḵ ’ap·pōw wə·ṯi·p̄·ʾar·tō ‘ă·ḇōr ‘al- pā·ša‘
verses.literal: A man’s insight gives him patience . . . and his virtue is to overlook . . . an offense

verses.original: מֶ֑לֶךְ זַ֣עַף נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃ וּכְטַ֖ל עַל־ עֵ֣שֶׂב
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ za·‘ap̄ na·ham kak·kə·p̄îr rə·ṣō·w·nōw ū·ḵə·ṭal ‘al- ‘ê·śeḇ
verses.literal: A king’s rage is like the roar of a lion but his favor is like dew on the grass

verses.original: כְּסִ֑יל בֵּ֣ן לְ֭אָבִיו הַוֺּ֣ת מִדְיְנֵ֥י אִשָּֽׁה׃ טֹ֝רֵ֗ד וְדֶ֥לֶף
verses.transliteration: kə·sîl bên lə·’ā·ḇîw haw·wōṯ miḏ·yə·nê ’iš·šāh ṭō·rêḏ wə·ḏe·lep̄
verses.literal: A foolish son is his father’s ruin and a quarrelsome wife is like a constant dripping

verses.original: בַּ֣יִת וָ֭הוֹן נַחֲלַ֣ת אָב֑וֹת מַשְׂכָּֽלֶת׃ אִשָּׁ֥ה וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: ba·yiṯ wā·hō·wn na·ḥă·laṯ ’ā·ḇō·wṯ maś·kā·leṯ ’iš·šāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: Houses and wealth are inherited from fathers but a prudent wife [is] from the LORD

verses.original: עַ֭צְלָה תַּפִּ֣יל תַּרְדֵּמָ֑ה רְמִיָּ֣ה וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ תִרְעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aṣ·lāh tap·pîl tar·dê·māh rə·mî·yāh wə·ne·p̄eš ṯir·‘āḇ
verses.literal: Laziness brings on deep sleep and an idle soul will suffer hunger

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ בּוֹזֵ֖ה דְרָכָ֣יו יוּמָת׃
verses.transliteration: šō·mêr miṣ·wāh šō·mêr nap̄·šōw bō·w·zêh ḏə·rā·ḵāw yū·må̄ṯ
verses.literal: He who keeps a commandment preserves his soul [but] he who is careless in his ways will die

verses.original: ח֣וֹנֵֽן דָּ֑ל וּ֝גְמֻל֗וֹ מַלְוֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה יְשַׁלֶּם־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·w·nên dāl ū·ḡə·mu·lōw mal·wêh Yah·weh yə·šal·lem- lōw
verses.literal: Kindness to the poor . . . is a loan to the LORD and He will repay [the lender]

verses.original: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ כִּי־ יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה אַל־ תִּשָּׂ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃ וְאֶל־ הֲ֝מִית֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: yas·sêr bin·ḵā kî- yêš tiq·wāh ’al- tiś·śā nap̄·še·ḵā wə·’el- hă·mî·ṯōw
verses.literal: Discipline your son for in that there is hope do not be party . . . to his death

verses.original: גֹּרַל חֵ֭מָה נֹ֣שֵׂא עֹ֑נֶשׁ כִּ֥י אִם־ תַּ֝צִּ֗יל וְע֣וֹד תּוֹסִֽף׃
verses.transliteration: gō·ral ḥê·māh nō·śê ‘ō·neš kî ’im- taṣ·ṣîl wə·‘ō·wḏ tō·w·sip̄
verses.literal: A man of great anger . . . must pay the penalty . . . if you rescue [him] vvv you will have to do so again

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע עֵ֭צָה וְקַבֵּ֣ל מוּסָ֑ר לְ֝מַ֗עַן תֶּחְכַּ֥ם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ ‘ê·ṣāh wə·qab·bêl mū·sār lə·ma·‘an teḥ·kam bə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Listen to counsel and accept discipline that you may be wise the rest of your days

verses.original: רַבּ֣וֹת מַחֲשָׁב֣וֹת אִ֑ישׁ בְּלֶב־ וַעֲצַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תָקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bō·wṯ ma·ḥă·šā·ḇō·wṯ ’îš bə·leḇ- wa·‘ă·ṣaṯ Yah·weh hî ṯā·qūm
verses.literal: Many plans are in a man’s heart but the purpose . . . of the LORD will prevail

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְטֽוֹב־ רָ֝שׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ כָּזָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ta·’ă·waṯ ’ā·ḏām ḥas·dōw wə·ṭō·wḇ- rāš mê·’îš kā·zāḇ
verses.literal: The desire of a man is loving devotion better to be poor than a liar

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה לְחַיִּ֑ים יָ֝לִ֗ין וְשָׂבֵ֥עַ בַּל־ יִפָּ֥קֶד רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh lə·ḥay·yîm yā·lîn wə·śā·ḇê·a‘ bal- yip·pā·qeḏ rā‘
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD leads to life that one may rest content without visitation from harm

verses.original: עָצֵ֣ל טָ֘מַ֤ן יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת לֹ֣א גַּם־ יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃ אֶל־ פִּ֝֗יהוּ
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ṣêl ṭā·man yā·ḏōw baṣ·ṣal·lā·ḥaṯ lō gam- yə·šî·ḇen·nāh ’el- pî·hū
verses.literal: The slacker buries his hand in the dish he will not even bring it back to his mouth

verses.original: תַּ֭כֶּה לֵ֣ץ וּפֶ֣תִי יַעְרִ֑ם וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ לְ֝נָב֗וֹן יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: tak·keh lêṣ ū·p̄e·ṯî ya‘·rim wə·hō·w·ḵî·aḥ lə·nā·ḇō·wn yā·ḇîn dā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Strike a mocker and the simple will beware rebuke the discerning [man] and he will gain knowledge

verses.original: מְֽשַׁדֶּד־ אָ֭ב יַבְרִ֣יחַ אֵ֑ם בֵּ֝֗ן מֵבִ֥ישׁ וּמַחְפִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: mə·šad·deḏ- ’āḇ yaḇ·rî·aḥ ’êm bên mê·ḇîš ū·maḥ·pîr
verses.literal: He who assaults his father or evicts his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace

verses.original: חַֽדַל־ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר בְּ֭נִי לִ֝שְׁג֗וֹת מֵֽאִמְרֵי־ דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥa·ḏal- liš·mō·a‘ mū·sār bə·nī liš·ḡō·wṯ mê·’im·rê- ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: If you cease to hear instruction my son you will stray from the words of knowledge

verses.original: בְּ֭לִיַּעַל עֵ֣ד יָלִ֣יץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים וּפִ֥י יְבַלַּע־ אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·lî·ya·‘al ‘êḏ yā·lîṣ miš·pāṭ rə·šā·‘îm ū·p̄î yə·ḇal·la‘- ’ā·wen
verses.literal: A corrupt witness mocks justice and a wicked mouth swallows iniquity

verses.original: שְׁפָטִ֑ים נָכ֣וֹנוּ לַלֵּצִ֣ים וּ֝מַהֲלֻמ֗וֹת לְגֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šə·p̄ā·ṭîm nā·ḵō·w·nū lal·lê·ṣîm ū·ma·hă·lu·mō·wṯ lə·ḡêw kə·sî·lîm
verses.literal: Judgments are prepared for mockers and beatings for the backs of fools
